description: Gujarat, through the Gujarat Knowledge Society, has opened a Green Skills & Applied AI Centre of Excellence at L.D. College of Engineering, Ahmedabad, with 1M1B Foundation, MeitY Startup Hub and Microsoft, aiming to train up to 3 lakh youth for the state's semiconductor and clean-tech economy.
body_lead: Gujarat has opened its first Green Skills & Applied AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) at L.D. College of Engineering (LDCE), Navrangpura, Ahmedabad, as the state looks to build a talent pipeline for its fast-growing semiconductor and advanced-technology industry. The centre has been set up by the Government of Gujarat, through the Gujarat Knowledge Society (GKS), with the 1M1B (One Million for One Billion) Foundation, MeitY Startup Hub and Microsoft.
